member.name: T:LinkedIn.Modules.Jobs.Domain.Entities.Application
member.summary: A candidate's application to one job. JobId is a REAL EF foreign key (same DbContext as Job/Company), but CandidateUserId is a plain string - AppUser lives in the Users module's own DbContext, so there's no live join possible there regardless. CandidateName/Email are snapshotted at apply-time for the same reason GetJobsHandler denormalizes Company.Name onto Job.
